text:
alex: Starting a canary for the v2 API schema evolution (rename `metadata` -> `meta`). Rolling to 5% traffic in prod-us-east-1 now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: v2-schema-evol-2026 on prod-us-east-1 (5% traffic). Logs streaming: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary/1718234567

tina: Heads up — mobile SDKs still parse `metadata`. @sdk-team we need a fast patch or to hold.

sdk-team: On it. We have a patch to fallback to `metadata` if `meta` missing, but need ~30m to cut a build.

josh: Observability note — schema telemetry doesn't have a tag for the new field yet. Nina, can you add a quick transform so metrics don't drop out of the dashboard?

nina: Yep adding transform to metrics pipeline now. ETA 10m.

alex: If SDK patch is >15m I want to pause the rollout and pin mobile clients to v1 for safety. Mobile accounts for 28% of the canary traffic.

sdk-team: Build queued. If tests pass we can ship in ~25m.

josh: I'm seeing a small spike in 4xx on the canary group: `400 Bad Request - missing field`. Sending sample logs.

alex: paste logs?

josh: ```
{"req_id":"abc123","endpoint":"/v2/generate","body":{"input":"hi"},"error":"missing required field: meta"}
```

nina: Those look like older mobile clients. Transform will prevent metric gaps but won't fix request validation.

alex: OK. Pause the canary. @deploy-bot pause canary 1718234567.

deploy-bot: Canary 1718234567 paused by alex. Current traffic frozen at 5%. Snapshotting instances.

tina: Rolling back validation change on the v2 validator to accept `metadata` as alias for `meta` so older clients don't 4xx. We'll cut a rollback patch to canary in-place.

sdk-team: We'll expedite the SDK patch but if you can accept alias server-side that's faster.

josh: Agree. Server-side aliasing is quickest. Are there any downstream consumers that will break if both fields present?

nina: No, it should be additive. I'll coordinate with infra to promote the alias patch to canary after QA.

alex: For the record: decision = pause -> add server-side alias -> resume canary once alias is live -> follow up with SDK patched release and release notes calling out field rename and compatibility behavior.

tina: I'll update release notes draft: add migration section, example curl and note about SDK rollout.

tina: Example snippet for notes: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"input":"hello","meta":{}}' 
```

alex: Thanks. Also add a short line for ops: "If you see `missing required field: meta`, pause and check canary alias rollout."

sdk-team: Thanks, we'll fast-track SDK builds and post status here.

deploy-bot: Canary 1718234567 resumed: alias-validation-v2 applied to canary group. Traffic at 5%.

josh: Metrics look stable so far, 4xx down to baseline.

alex: Good. Keep canary at 5% for 1 hour, then we can consider a staged increase if no regression. Follow-up action items:
- tina: finalize release notes and send to product for approval.
- sdk-team: ship SDK patch and notify mobile apps team.
- nina: confirm metrics pipeline shows `meta` adoption and alert on drops.

nina: Acknowledged. I'll push an alert runbook link when I finish.

alex: Closing thread for now, will reopen if anything odd. :thumbsup:
